boundary-fixture-correction.json.correction: MyRandom.setRandom deliberately wraps a global provider in CountingRandom. Capture the installed provider after setting it, and require that exact object is restored. Retain underlying Random state comparison and add global callCount preservation to protect live undo. No weaker requirement; first report retained.

goad-fixture-correction.json.reason: Player.equals deliberately uses stable IDs across copied games. isGoadedBy uses value equality, so rejecting the original Player via that query was an invalid identity check. Correct the fixture to assert the actual map value is the exact copied Player object and is not the original object. Keep timestamp, requirement-legality and independent mutation assertions unchanged.

goad-fixture-phase-correction.json.reason: The native goad requirement validator consults the active game combat as well as the supplied declaration. Register each supplied legal/forbidden combat with its phase handler before validation. The missing setup caused eight null-combat failures after v5 identity/timestamp checks passed. All assertions retained; v2 reports preserved.
